Review complete. The full write-up is at `/home/vscode/.claude/plans/review-this-evidence-backed-performance-tidy-panda.md`. Summary:

**Verdict: PASS for a bounded POC, with the mechanism re-stated and four required changes. Not a BLOCK.**

**Causal evidence holds, and is stronger than stated.** From the ISC004 events, node 35 on tests/admin_views/tests.py walks a mean bucket of 49,516 rows per probe, so `preceding` has two partitions of ~49.5k tokens each. That is ~4.9 billion pair visits for one file, half of them passing the inequality. The index is used. The cost is the chain walk, which is Σ group² by construction since nothing orders a hash chain by a value column. Caveat: the observed 516k pairs/s is instrumented and suspiciously slow. The production kernel's per-pair cost is unknown and should be measured once before committing, because a large constant factor would touch every join in the pack.

**The shape is generic, and its frequency is countable, not UNKNOWN.** I surveyed the frozen pack: 214 antijoin-of-self-join sites in 85 rules, 202 with a single strict same-column comparison, 12 compound lexicographic, 9 projecting right-side columns, 4 multi-consumer, 26 with partition keys not a subset of the antijoin keys. But partition size decides gain, not site count. Most sites partition by call, with buckets of 2 to 10 rows. The top completed leaders are mostly not this shape at all. PT020, PT025 and PT026 carry it, but their 1.6 GB peaks point at the preceding file-only-key range joins, of which the pack has 221 sites in 56 rules. Expected gain is honestly "ISC004 goes from censored to completed" plus unmeasured small wins.

**Mechanism must be re-stated.** Replace only `Project(Dropped) ← Select(l.c < r.c) ← Join(S,S)` with `Project(Dropped) ← Flag(c < max_p(c)) ← Extremum_p(S)`. Leave the antijoin untouched. Source confirms the antijoin is set membership on the right key with left duplicates kept and right fully held, so right multiplicity is irrelevant and the only proof obligation is set equality of the right side. This also kills the one real trap: two left rows sharing the antijoin key with different ordered values, where only one is dominated, must both be removed. A per-row existence view keeps one. That fixture must be in the falsifiers verbatim. The 26 key-mismatch sites need no special handling under this formulation.

**Over-scoping.** Owners, leases, retention, sharing and publication belong to secondary holes 2 and 3. The extremum map is per-step scratch, consumed once. The existing `column_kernel` recogniser in core domain is the exact precedent for placement, with the kernel beside the portable equality join in the operators crate. No new Operation variant, no RyoQL change, no env switch.

**Acceptance has a hole.** ISC004 has never completed on the full corpus, so "default vs POC exact report" has no default side yet. The 720 s retry is live. The real semantic oracle is the other 84 shape-bearing rules, all of which complete under default. Eliminated pairs are measurable today from `equality_matches` at recognised nodes without writing kernel code.

**Confirmed, not equivalent by name.** Rank is a text-set index lookup. OrderedMatch is a greedy one-to-one FIFO pairing that errors on duplicate order values, which alone rules it out since equal `token_end` is legal.

One aside outside the POC: the hash-index join branch never consults `Join.filter`, while the tree branch does. Lowering never produces that case today, but nothing enforces it.
